The two transfer legs are written through PH-239's non-routed record_internal_classification with two distinct request tokens (each leg gets its own CashReceipt action=cash_classification.record); the reversal calls reverse_classification twice with two distinct tokens (each gets its own CashReceipt action=cash_classification.reverse). InternalTransferReceipt is separate (action=link/reverse, org+token unique). The report discloses these receipt rows; no public HTTP/PAT/canonical transfer entry is exposed.

Unique(out_cash_transaction) and Unique(in_cash_transaction) are unconditional lifetime constraints: a cash fact never participates in a second transfer, not even after the first transfer is reversed. This matches the frozen PH-245 spec.

InternalTransferReversal is an append-only owned fact (org, internal_transfer unique FK + internal_transfer_ref, out/in classification reversal refs, occurred_on, posting_period, status=posted, version) so the canonical reversed event can use source kind internal_transfer_reversal; this model was added per the Lead ruling and canonical contract.
